annotations.title: Baroque Ground Bass Phrasing
annotations.instruction: Emphasize the deep G minor ground bass steps (Gm - Cm - F - Bb - Eb - Cm - D7 - Gm). Let each harmony resolve with nobility.

annotations.title: Staccato Sparkle & Voice Separation
annotations.instruction: Crisp finger staccato in the accompaniment while keeping the cantabile soprano melody line soaring effortlessly.

annotations.title: Weight Transfer in Double Octaves
annotations.instruction: Transfer forearm weight directly into the keybeds. Keep wrists supple to avoid arm tension in rapid octave leaps.

sections.title: Ground Bass Theme (Maestoso)
sections.character: Dark, noble ground bass and grand baroque harmony
